headlines.title: Merck and Moderna say cancer vaccine shows promise in preventing recurrence of melanoma
headlines.description: Pharmaceutical giants Moderna and Merck said that an experimental vaccine treatment has shown signs of preventing skin cancer from returning or spreading in a study of melanoma patients.

headlines.title: Trump to nominate Heidi Overton to lead the FDA
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is expected to nominate physician Dr. Heidi Overton, a White House aide, to be his new FDA commissioner.

headlines.title: How to Keep Your Skin Healthy During the End of Summer
headlines.description: The end of summer can be rough on skin, so board-certified dermatologist Marnie Nussbaum stops by TODAY to share ways to keep your skin health and looking good. Tips include exfoliating once or twice a week, using the ABCDE rule to determine if a sunspot is cause for concern and more.

headlines.title: Costco Enters Medicare Market With Limited Launch
headlines.description: Costco is rolling out its own Medicare plans in a partnership with health insurer, Scan. The deal calls for a limited launch of Medicare advantage plans in two states, along with a Medicare supplement in a third.

headlines.title: New CDC Data Signal Downward Trend in Cyclospora Outbreak
headlines.description: The CDC's latest update shows that daily cases of cyclosporiasis are trending downward after a monthslong outbreak. The agency confirms more than 15,700 cases of cyclosporiasis since May 1 and says it’s looking into another nearly 12,000 potential cases. While those numbers are higher than last year for a similar time frame, medical professionals are cautiously optimistic. NBC’s Aaron Gilchrist reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Facial Acupuncture Benefits: Reduce Tension, Reset Cortisol, More
headlines.description: Dr. Taz Bhatia joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to share how facial acupuncture can release tension, reset cortisol and more.

headlines.title: The best styling products to keep flyaway hairs at bay
headlines.description: Our editors spent three months testing hair styling products to keep flyaways, baby hairs and frizz at bay. Shop the best options from Dae, Briogeo, Fenty Beauty and more.

headlines.title: Tick prevention for dogs: Vets explain how to beat the blood-suckers
headlines.description: Dogs are more vulnerable to Lyme disease than ever. These are the best vet-approved tick preventatives for dogs and how to check your dog for ticks.

headlines.title: 21 products you actually need when your kid starts school for the first time — from a mom of 3
headlines.description: A mom of three researched, shopped and tested back-to-school gear for her kid who’s going to Pre-K for the first time. Here, she shares the best products for parents who want quality, including backpacks, lunch boxes, clothing, tech and organization essentials worth buying before the year starts.

headlines.title: Is NeeDoh the new Labubu? Why people are obsessed with the viral squishies and why the company is being sued
headlines.description: NeeDoh is a popular brand of squishy toys that have gone viral. Trend experts reveal why they’re so popular. Plus, five other squishies available on Amazon.

headlines.title: Childhood vaccine exemptions for personal or religious reasons hit new record, CDC finds
headlines.description: The number of parents in the U.S. choosing not to vaccinate their children rose dramatically in the last school year, according to data released Monday by the CDC.

headlines.title: Ticks that cause Lyme and other diseases have migrated south. Are doctors ready?
headlines.description: New research from the CDC finds that ticks that cause diseases keep marching into new areas.
